projects.title: University PDF Assistant
projects.description: AI-powered PDF assistant for document understanding and intelligent question answering.
projects.details: Developed an AI-powered PDF Assistant that enables users to upload academic and university documents and receive context-aware answers. Implemented Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) using LangChain and FAISS for semantic document retrieval, while leveraging the Gemini API to generate accurate responses through an interactive Streamlit interface.

projects.title: Bangla News Q&A Bot (RAG)
projects.description: Retrieval-Augmented Generation system for answering questions from Bangla news articles.
projects.details: Built a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system that retrieves relevant context from Bangla news articles and generates accurate answers to user queries. Implemented document chunking, vector embeddings, semantic search with FAISS, and LangChain-based retrieval pipelines to improve response quality and relevance.

Implemented semantic similarity analysis using Sentence Transformers and developed an interactive dashboard with Streamlit.

projects.title: Privacy-Preserving Explainable Federated Transfer Learning for Brain Tumor Segmentation
projects.description: Federated MRI brain tumor segmentation with CNN-based and Transformer-based U-Net.
projects.details: Contributed to a privacy-preserving federated learning framework for MRI-based brain tumor segmentation, working with CNN-based U-Net and Transformer-based U-Net architectures across centralized, federated, IID, and Non-IID settings. Evaluated model performance using Dice, IoU, Precision, Recall, and F1-score.

projects.title: Explainable Hybrid Deep Learning Framework for Bangla Fake News Detection
projects.description: BERT & XLM-RoBERTa embeddings with classical ML and LIME explanations.
projects.details: Contributed to Bangla fake news detection using BERT and XLM-RoBERTa-based language representations combined with conventional machine learning approaches. Worked with hybrid modeling and explainability techniques, including LIME, to improve model interpretation and analysis.

projects.title: Category-Guided Intelligence: Explainable Multi-Task Framework for Bengali Fake News Detection
projects.description: BanglaBERT + BiLSTM + attention with category-aware multi-task learning.
projects.details: Contributed to an explainable multi-task framework for Bengali fake news detection by combining BanglaBERT, BiLSTM, attention mechanisms, and category-aware learning. Worked with LIME, SHAP, and attention-based analysis to interpret model predictions and evaluate model behavior.

projects.title: Privacy-Preserving Federated Learning for Colorectal Cancer Detection
projects.description: FedAvg-based deep learning on distributed healthcare data.
projects.details: Developed a privacy-preserving federated learning framework for colorectal cancer detection using distributed healthcare data. Implemented deep learning-based federated training with the FedAvg algorithm and evaluated model performance under distributed learning settings.

projects.title: Privacy-Preserving Federated Learning for Pancreatic Malignancy Detection
projects.description: Federated learning framework for pancreatic cancer detection using SEER clinical data.
projects.details: Contributed to a federated learning framework for pancreatic cancer detection using SEER clinical data, implementing ANN-based models and FedAvg aggregation in distributed healthcare settings.
